name: @ohdsi/notebook-git
description: Server-side git mirror and notebook templates for the Atlas notebook plugin. Published under @ohdsi so trex treats it as a first-party plugin: its routes mount at /plugins/ohdsi/ and are guarded by trex's own auth (authContext + pluginAuthz) rather than the legacy d2e Logto path, which is unusable when D2E_IDP_MODE=trex because no Logto is running to serve the JWKS.
